title.narrative: The National Plan of Action for Children was launched, establishing a time-bound framework to strengthen child protection systems in internationally recognized Government controlled areas. UNICEF strengthened the capacity of 770 social service and justice personnel, constituting 65 per cent of a target of 1,187; verified nearly 99 per cent of reported grave violations; and implemented the Children and Armed conflict (CAAC) Action Plan.
